subject.title: Feature request: Read pinned Telegram messages via bot API

question: Should OpenClaw expose Telegram pinned-message reads now, and should the first version be an explicit gated on-demand action/command or automatic session context injection?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior decides how durable Telegram room context is authorized, exposed to agents, and optionally injected into session state.

options.title: On-demand gated read first
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned read-pinned or list-pins action backed by the chat pinned message, behind an explicit gate and without automatic session-start injection.

options.title: Fold into broader Telegram read design
options.body: Keep this tied to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/12756 until maintainers settle the retained-history and read-tool contract for Telegram.

options.title: Defer automatic pinned context
options.body: Do not fetch pins into session context until a separate opt-in storage, truncation, and prompt-injection policy is approved.

recommendation.title: On-demand gated read first
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned read-pinned or list-pins action backed by the chat pinned message, behind an explicit gate and without automatic session-start injection.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent ownership signal across the Telegram action/docs surfaces and are the best available route for the product/security choice.
